test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

In the __absence of government rule__, riots have broken out all over the country and everything is in a state of complete chaos.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Anarchy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anarchy"** refers to a state of disorder due to the absence or non-recognition of authority or other controlling systems. (अराजकता)
 
• **​"Anarchy"** describes a situation where there is no government, and lawlessness prevails. (अराजकता)
 
 
• **Example:** With no leadership in place, the region quickly fell into **anarchy**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Anarchy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Oligarchy** (कुलीनतंत्र): A small group of people having control of a country, organization, or institution.

 
 
• **Example:** The nation was ruled by an **oligarchy **of wealthy elites.
 
 
 
• **Dictatorship** (तानाशाही): A country governed by a dictator.
 
 
• **Example:** Under the dictator's rule, the country experienced severe oppression.
 
 
 
• **Monarchy** (राजशाही): A form of government with a monarch at the head.
 
 
• **Example:** The country is a constitutional **monarchy**, where the king has limited powers.
